title: VTC Events — Attachments — Add — payload
description: A host attaches to an event a community room bound to its roster, an opt-in room, a board whose audience is the event, a community election, or a material released to each registrant who is going. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

roomId.description: For `room` and `optInRoom`: the community room's DID.

admits.description: For `room`: whom it admits. Absent means `going`.

disclosure.description: For `optInRoom`, REQUIRED: what a registrant is told before entering — that those in it see each other. Plain text.

boardId.description: For `board`: a board whose audience is this event — an audience `vtc/boards/_shared/0.2` states (`vtc/boards/create` 0.2).

Response.title: VTC Events — Attachments — Add — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/attachments/add/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/attachments/add/0.1#response.
